title: Optimizing Physical Neural Networks through Device Variable Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.33522v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physical neural networks (PNNs) leverage device physics in electronics, optics, and related domains to enable energy-efficient neural networks. Broken-isomorphism PNNs replace linear operations with multivariate physical transformations, modifying how input signals are mapped to device variables. We exploit network architectures emerging from these mappings by treating the routing between signals and input variables of physical devices as trainable parameters. This approach expands device-level tunability of the physical transformations while, at the system level, demonstrating improved expressivity of PNNs with negligible additional inference overhead. This discrete routing is optimized by training a categorical distribution using Gumbel-Softmax reparametrization. We evaluate this approach using experimentally calibrated differentiable models of multivariate electronic RNPUs for MNIST and CIFAR-10 classification. Using variable select

translated_title: 通过器件变量选择优化物理神经网络
translated_abstract: 物理神经网络（PNNs）利用电子学、光学及相关领域的器件物理特性，实现高能效的神经网络。破缺同构物理神经网络（broken-isomorphism PNNs）用多变量物理变换取代线性运算，从而改变了输入信号映射到器件变量的方式。我们通过将信号与物理器件输入变量之间的路由视为可训练参数，来利用这些映射所产生的网络架构。该方法扩展了物理变换在器件层面的可调性，同时在系统层面以几乎可忽略的额外推理开销提升了PNN的表达能力。这种离散路由通过使用Gumbel-Softmax重参数化训练分类分布来优化。我们使用经过实验校准的多变量电子RNPU可微分模型，在MNIST和CIFAR-10分类任务上评估了该方法。
tldr: 提出将信号与物理器件输入变量之间的路由作为可训练参数，并利用Gumbel-Softmax重参数化优化这种离散路由选择，在几乎不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升了物理神经网络的表达能力。
en_tdlr: This paper treats the routing between input signals and physical device variables as trainable parameters, optimized via Gumbel-Softmax reparametrization, thereby improving the expressivity of physical neural networks with negligible additional inference overhead.
